title: Outbox uncertainty and journal limits
summary: Interrupted provider calls may have effected a remote side effect. An unknown state requires external reconciliation, not blind replay. Development journal has no fsync or multiwriter guarantee.
invariants: UNKNOWN is not RETRYABLE absent reconciliation proof.
Append integrity is not crash durability, lock fencing or distributed exactly-once.
